title: 11 Days Of Development and People Are Actually Playing The Game! And The Hard Parts
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
Its been 11 days since this game start with nothing but a concept and now its a playable demo and something that go into early play testing.

[Play Online or PC Here](https://www.glitch.fun/games/ad467bbb-ca91-44e9-8016-5067cdce954c/play)

Not perfect, and has lots of area of refinement, but the fact that a tangebile game with this level of functionality and detail can be inside someones hands in 11 days is amazing.

Two hardest parts thus far:

*  **Lots of Assets:** City builders have A LOT of assets; think about how every building is different, and then you have close to 40 buildings  that 3D! Add on aliens, roadways, trains, boats and there is about 150 assets in the game. This took about 4 days to do.
* **WebGPU Performance:** 3D Web Games are already hard with WebGPU have limited capabilities, especially when you have projectiles. When you combine that with a city builder grid of having to maintain the state and and economy of an entire city, the draw calls can get insane, like 2k per frame. This was the hardest part, taking about **6 days**.

  
The [schedule for the AI Gaming Festiva](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/schedule/standalone)l is up, and there is going to be great talks about this kind of stuff.

Next steps for this project; refine the graphics wile keeps draw calls as as low as possible.
